profile.headline: Sr Staff Software Engineer @ Tesla | Software Engineering Lead
profile.summary:
As a Sr Staff Software Engineer at Tesla, I apply my 14+ years of software development experience and my expertise in C# and web applications to create innovative software solutions for the company's electric vehicles. I am passionate about using cutting-edge technologies and best practices to deliver high-quality products that meet the needs and expectations of Tesla's customers and stakeholders.

In addition to developing software features and functionalities, I also contribute to the software architecture and design of Tesla's systems, applying OOP and SOLID principles and patterns, and ensuring scalability, performance, and security. I also lead and coach other software engineers, facilitating knowledge sharing, collaboration, and continuous improvement. My mission is to support Tesla's vision of accelerating the world's transition to sustainable energy through software engineering excellence.

A natural leader who fosters a collaborative and inclusive work environment. Strong ability to empathize with team members and understand their needs. Ready to bring my expertise and drive results

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to develop and implement innovative software solutions for Tesla's Transportation Management System, Billing System and ATS ensuring efficient and reliable business operations.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure effective communication and collaboration throughout the software development lifecycle
Manage a team of software engineers and provide technical guidance and mentorship to drive the success of software development projects at Tesla.
Develop and implement a comprehensive training program for the technical team to enhance their skills and knowledge in Microsoft technologies and software development best practices.
Lead the technical direction and strategy for software development projects at Tesla, leveraging Microsoft technologies to drive innovative solutions and improve business operations.
Create and maintain technical documentation and knowledge base for software solutions developed at Tesla.
Collaborate with HR team to identify and address any talent gaps within the technical team, and develop strategies to attract and retain top talent in the industry.
